title: Griddled English Muffins with Nooks and Crannies
summary: A soft milk dough is rolled, cut and proved on semolina, griddled slowly on both sides and finished briefly in the oven until cooked through.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
large heavy frying pan or griddle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine semolina or cornmeal, for dusting

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast, sugar and salt together, add the warm milk and melted butter and knead 8-10 minutes by hand or 5 minutes in a mixer until smooth.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1.5 hours until doubled.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Dust a tray with half the semolina. Roll the dough 2 cm thick and cut 8 rounds, re-rolling the scraps once. Dust the tops with the remaining semolina.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover loosely and leave 30-45 minutes until puffy. Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan).

steps.title: Griddle
steps.text: Cook in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 6-7 minutes per side until deep golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Bake 8-10 minutes until 93 °C in the centre. Cool 10 minutes, split with a fork and toast.

tips: Low heat is key: too hot and the outside burns before the middle cooks.
The oven finish guarantees no doughy centre.
Splitting with a fork, not a knife, keeps the craggy texture.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature and eat within 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Refresh in a hot oven for a few minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
